indications_and_usage: Uses This homeopathic medicine is made from a combination of ingredients traditionally used to help relieve symptoms of*: restlessness, nervousness, irritability, agitation, sleeplessness, lessen nightmares. *These claims have not been reviewed by the Food and Drug Administration. They are based on traditional homeopathic practice, not medical evidence.
warnings: Warnings Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms worsen: If you are pregnant or breast feeding , ask a health professional before. Keep out of reach of children . In case of accidental overdose, contact a medical professional or poison control center immediately.
